title: sync script: timeout 900 lacks -k; hung TERM-ignoring session wedges the sync loop forever
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 passes 1.4/3.3 (converged). sync-beads-workers.sh:110 'timeout 900 opencode run' sends TERM then waits indefinitely if the child ignores it; the :99 comment's 15-min guarantee does not hold, and rc=124 path (:316) then races surviving grandchildren writing the worktree. Fix: timeout -k <grace> 900.
close_reason: Fixed: timeout 900 -> timeout -k 10 900 for the LLM merge session; log line documents 124 (TERM sufficed) vs 137 (TERM ignored then KILLed). Verified via GNU timeout mechanism checks + sandbox suite on a scaled copy (-k 1 3): TERM-ignoring session AND its TERM-ignoring same-group grandchild both dead, sync exit 1 wall 4s (previously: infinite wedge), branch reported manual; TERM-compliant session rc=124; happy path with RESOLVED sentinel unchanged. bash -n + shellcheck clean. 3x delegated kimi-k3 review: edge pass clean; correctness+security passes found one P3 comment-accuracy issue (grace KILL only fires while the session leader is awaited — a TERM-compliant leader with a TERM-ignoring grandchild exits 124 with the grandchild surviving past the pin's single sample); fixed per prescription (comment reworded + grandchild-survivor case added to the pin's documented residuals); round-2 verification pass confirmed accuracy. Follow-up filed: j070 (merge-janitor.sh:33 has the same timeout-without-k hazard, plus lacks the d42k pin entirely). Note: branch merged main in first (worker6's staged-set-bound/session-log evolution) to avoid sync conflicts.
